preconditions.description: Both input strings must have lengths between 1 and 100, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {'*', '#', '@'} for c in str1) and all(c in {'*', '#', '@'} for c in str2)
preconditions.description: Each character in str1 and str2 must be one of '*', '#', or '@'.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max(sum(1 for i in range(len(str1)) for j in range(len(str2)) if str1[i] == str2[j] and not any(str1[i] == str2[k] for k in range(j) if str1[i] == str2[k]) and not any(str1[l] == str2[j] for l in range(i) if str1[l] == str2[j])))
postconditions.description: The function returns the maximum number of bridges that can be built, where each bridge connects a unique pair of trees of the same type from str1 and str2, and no two bridges share a tree from either side.
